mapper.sql: id, email, password_hash, username, display_name, bio, icon_image_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, username, display_name) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{username}, #{displayName}) RETURNING id
mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.icon_image_key, u.created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = u.id) AS following_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.following_id = u.id) AS follower_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.following_id = u.id) AS following, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = u.id AND f.following_id = #{viewerId}) AS followed_by
mapper.select: WITH matched AS ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.icon_image_key, lower(normalize(u.display_name, NFKC)) AS name_key FROM users u ) SELECT m.id AS user_id, m.username, m.display_name, m.bio, m.icon_image_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows v WHERE v.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND v.following_id = m.id) AS following, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows v WHERE v.follower_id = m.id AND v.following_id = #{viewerId}) AS followed_by FROM matched m WHERE m.username LIKE #{contains} ESCAPE '\' OR m.name_key LIKE #{contains} ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.username = #{text} THEN 0 WHEN m.username LIKE #{prefix} ESCAPE '\' OR m.name_key LIKE #{prefix} ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, (SELECT count(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.following_id = m.id) DESC, m.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
